name: BirdNET-Go
author: ChuckBuilds
description: Show what BirdNET-Go is hearing. One screen cycles a different species each turn — name, confidence, how many times it has been heard today, and a photo — and a second shows today's stats: species count, total detections and the most-heard species. Polls the BirdNET-Go REST API, with optional MQTT for instant pop-ups.

versions.notes: Documentation. The README explained the setup and the cycling logic well but had no configuration reference at all: 36 of the 39 settings were never named, including every text colour, the whole field_mapping block, and most of the display block. All 39 are now documented by key, grouped by area. Adds real rendered screenshots -- the detection card, show_confidence and show_today_count on and off, a long species name scrolling on a narrow panel and fitting on a wide one, and four panel sizes.
Mark MQTT broker password as x-secret so the web UI masks it.
